description: Implementation of the E1AP CU-CP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and procedure invocation for a 3GPP-compliant network component.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_cp_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing the E1AP CU-CP protocol logic, including message handling, UE context management, and procedure coordination.

classes.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Helper class that wraps message notifications with logging functionality.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the protocol handling, setting stopping flag and launching stop procedure.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_e1_reset_message
methods.description: Processes E1 Reset messages, handling stopping state and invoking reset procedures.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_response
methods.description: Handles responses to CU-UP E1 setup, sending success or failure messages.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Processes bearer context setup requests, allocating UE IDs and invoking setup procedures.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Handles bearer context modification requests, invoking modification procedures.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_command
methods.description: Processes bearer context release commands, invoking release procedures.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Main message dispatcher, parsing and routing incoming E1AP messages.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Handles initial E1AP messages based on their type, such as setup requests and release requests.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_request
methods.description: Processes bearer context release requests from the network.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_inactivity_notification
methods.description: Handles inactivity notifications for bearer contexts, possibly triggering UE release.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Handles successful outcome messages, updating UE context and transaction states.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Handles unsuccessful outcome messages, updating UE context and transaction states.

methods.name: cancel_ue_tasks
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing tasks related to a specific UE.

methods.name: update_ue_context
methods.description: Transfers UE context from an old to a new UE index.

methods.name: remove_bearer_context
methods.description: Removes UE context from internal storage.

methods.name: log_pdu
methods.description: Logs the contents of an E1AP message, with optional UE index annotation.
